label: early-episode GO step, committing strongly to a2 after a rewarded trial
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (98.5% of mass), and only in the first ~20 trials of an episode (none after trial 30, none on trials 0-2). It needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (100% of mass has prev_reward=1) and the agent to be choosing a2: essentially all activations fall on a2 choices, mostly a2-stay after a rewarded a2 trial, with a strong a2 policy logit (choice < -8.9 holds 87% of mass) and high value (7.7-8.1). It is much more frequent in episodes that start with S2 good (95% of mass). Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded a2 GO of a run and decays over consecutive rewarded a2 repeats (e.g. 1.00, 0.82, 0.69, 0.59), which is the main source of false positives in later trials of a run. A small amount of activation at D1 when a reward is shown. Never fires at D2, on a1 choices, after unrewarded trials, or late in the episode. The recorded predicate uses only observed or computed quantities (the model policy logit at GO, previous reward, episode time); dev F1 0.76, mass recall 0.95. Adding prev_action/start_high or prev_common did not help.
